Attached are our initial redlines (MSA_redlines_from_Novagen.pdf). High level:
- We flagged the indemnity and liability caps as material; will propose language that limits Redwood’s liability in line with our standard procurement terms.

Thanks for the redlines — received and reviewed at a high level. A few notes: 

- Indemnity / liability: we can accept adjusted caps but will need to preserve exclusions for gross negligence and PV/third-party claims. I’ll circulate counters on tracked doc by EOD Friday.
- DPA / data residency: Redwood supports region-specific controls. For the pilot we can add the 30-day remediate clause as a compromise. For production we’ll need the EU-only residency language and an implementation timeline.
- Audit logs: 12 months retention is reasonable; can you confirm retention scope (access logs only vs full event logs)?

I’ll coordinate with Olga on the DocuSign envelope setup and share the revised MSA + DPA summary (DPA_summary_Redwood.pdf) once counters are in. Proposed next steps added to the MAP: designate a single legal point-of-contact from each side and schedule a 45-min run-through to close open redlines.
